tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.57; also called Amon at Neh.7.59;
Another name of a.mi (אָמִי "Ami" H0532)
§ Amon = "skilled workman" or "master workman"
1) a king of Judah, son of Manasseh
2) a governor of Samaria
3) a descendant of a servant of Solomon

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Amon, the name of three Israelites
